BULKY VERY LOOSE fully opaque ivory HIGH TURTLENECK with broad folded collar covers neck base and all upper chest, unshaped fabric, no neckline/cleavage/fitted contours/sleeveless. Entire head and all hair edges with generous crown and side margin. Light neutral studio background and soft daylight; all face/hair sharp at genuine native supported resolution >=1024 longedge; full portrait 4:5 source aspect. No upscaling/8K, blur/grain/fog, collage, text, logo, watermark, jewellery or celebrity likeness. A fictional ADULT Middle Eastern woman with olive skin and dark eyes, age 61. PRIMARY thin-hair styling constraint: fine wispy LIGHT LOW-DENSITY hair, modest airy low-volume mass, separate thin sections, small scalp glimpses along part, natural full hairline, no medical depiction, no thick/dense/heavy dome or fringe. UPPER SECTIONS retain bob-like length and movement above a visibly shorter tapered pixie nape; genuine BOB-PIXIE HYBRID, not ordinary bob, close pixie or long wolf cut. Long divided airy forehead pieces open over middle forehead, eyes unobscured. Ear edges visible.
